data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 proposes a simulation but its description—'testing rivalry growth vs. retirement rates'—fails to specify what rival predictions the simulation discriminates between, which the problem explicitly requires ('a sandboxed Python simulation that discriminates between rival predictions'). Its own counterconditions supply candidate rival hypotheses (standing residue as intentional design feature vs. capacity bottleneck vs. closure-enforcement failure), yet the simulation proposal does not tie itself to discriminating among these. The problem further requests the simulation address 'how coverage debt grows with rivalry size under batched criticism,' but SRC_002's claim text mentions coverage debt only in passing ('validate coverage debt') without specifying how the simulation would measure or vary coverage debt as a function of rivalry size or batch structure. Without these design specifics, the simulation proposal is too vague to be criticizable or to discriminate between rival predictions.
